name: 妖狐巢穴
desc: 山林深处的妖狐聚居之地，适合初阶修士历练。
descEn: A fox spirit nest deep in the mountains, suitable for beginners.

name: 尸傀古墓
desc: 被邪术污染的古代墓室，深处有尸傀守护的宝藏。
descEn: An ancient tomb tainted by dark arts, guarded by corpse puppets.

name: 魔修殿堂
desc: 老牌魔修盘踞的地下殿堂，危险但收获丰厚。
descEn: Underground hall of a veteran demon cultivator. Dangerous but rewarding.

name: 封印异兽之地
desc: 远古封印崩裂后的异兽栖息地，化神以下勿入。
descEn: Habitat of primordial beasts after their seal shattered. Spirit Severing+ only.

name: 天罚试炼场
desc: 天道执法者驻守之地，唯有大乘修士方可挑战。
descEn: Domain of celestial enforcers. Only Mahayana cultivators may challenge.
